caseNameFull: John E. Hartenbower v. People of the State of Illinois
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Illinois.
attorneys: Mr. Harry C. Kinne for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Edward J. Brundage and Mr. James H. Wilkerson for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction, upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
